correctness.rationale: The exact polar equations follow by matrix subtraction of the clipped defects. At the unit circle four short caps each integrate to (4 sqrt(2)/3) eta^(3/2); uniform radial motion O(a) gives the O(a^(4/3)) return-map error on the eta=Theta(a^(2/3)) scale. Opposite signs at radii straddling C_* give an orbit. The section-normal speeds are both -b and Liouville plus identity saltation gives a return derivative in (0,1), hence annular uniqueness and stability. Reciprocal angular time and divergence integrals give the period and multiplier constants. The independent computation of the angular orbit for four parameter sets is consistent with each prediction but is not the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: After crediting the 1999/2005 near-grazing saturation results, the fractional exponents and existence of an order-one period correction are firmly prior. However, the 2005 planar Theorem 1 only applies to a single saturated scalar output, producing three zones and two parallel frontiers, whereas the original Ma et al. (2013) two-channel clipped feedback has independent perpendicular frontiers, four angular grazing caps, and different exact return-map constants. Ma et al. provide qualitative onset but no quantitative coefficient triple. No inspected theorem directly yields the particular coupling-independent amplitude constant together with the leading physical-period coefficient and Floquet coefficient. Priority against the inaccessible 1999 complete text remains provisional, so the pass concerns best-knowledge claim-specific noncoverage rather than certified first discovery.
residual_risks: The full Freire–Ponce–Ros 1999 origin theorem was not accessible: an unknown broader hypothesis could imply this model-specific four-cap asymptotic. This is a material but not presently decisive priority uncertainty. Authorized institutional retrieval was unavailable because the VPN was disconnected; no access restrictions were bypassed.
The already-established SISO exponents 2/3 and 1/3 may generalize by existing methods; only the precise four-cap coefficient triple is treated as candidate original here.
An earlier unindexed analysis of precisely the Ma et al. two-channel clipped system might have obtained all three coefficients.

value.rationale: The exponents 2/3 and 1/3 already arise in the 1999/2005 SISO saturation theory and are not intrinsically novel here. The mathematical gap is quantitative for an independently clipped two-channel, four-cap feedback system in the 2013 source: the exact coupling-independent selected-radius coefficient, coupled physical-time period response and b-dependent transverse Floquet prefactor require a four-cap Poincare calculation outside the single-saturation theorem hypotheses. These are natural invariant quantities for a critical limit cycle at the edge of a neutral period annulus, not an arbitrary tabulation or a negligible incremental bound.
